proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, Ibn Turka's works contain Sunni-side features: a Sharh al-Nahj in the Sunni manaqib tradition, mention of the Companions and Successors even in his most esoteric works, and a call in the Mafahis to follow the way of the Sunni forebears.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, author of Sharḥ al-Nahj; K. al-Mafaḥiṣ
mediation.note: A doctrinal work, not addressed to a judge; the duress rule counts a work as evidence of what he held.
We have the work only as MK summarises or translates it; most of the lettrist works are unedited, so MK's paraphrase cannot be checked against a printed text.
